articles.summary: Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD) announced that National Australia Bank (NAB) is modernizing customer experiences across its self-service network with more than 700 DN Series® cash recycling ATMs combined with the company's next-generation Vynamic ® Acquiring platform. Through 2028, NAB will upgrade its ATMs while transforming the software infrastructure that supports physical and digital transactions. Vynamic Acquiring is built on Diebold Nixdorf's Vynamic Transaction Middleware platform and uses cloud-native, microservices-based architecture. The solution will help NAB modernize its switching environment, support regulatory compliance and introduce new customer journeys. NAB's ATMs support more than 500,000 transactions each week, underscoring the continued importance of convenient, dependable cash access alongside digital and in-branch banking. The initiative will: Improve availability across NAB's network with modern, highly reliable ATMs, with at least two at most branches. Streamline
articles.title: National Australia Bank Modernizes ATM Network with Diebold Nixdorf Cash Recycling ATMs and Payments Platform
